axes.model_access: The platform ships no in-house model — it connects to various LLMs (OpenAI-compatible interfaces are the main axis); the hosted versions' (fastgpt.io/fastgpt.cn) built-in model list not verified item by item; the self-hosted version can attach local models (paired with runner-class tools).
axes.runtime: Two forms: open-source repo self-hosted (labring/FastGPT, GitHub direct 200, pushed same day 2026-10-30) + official hosted versions (fastgpt.io international direct 200; fastgpt.cn mainland direct 200, footer entity Guangzhou Huanji Cloud Computing Co., Ltd. + an ICP website registration on record, number in the cn block).
axes.local_files: In the self-hosted form data lives in your own databases (MongoDB/vector store — deployment docs on record); the hosted version keeps data in the official cloud. Knowledge-base files are ingested and vectorized after upload; raw-file retention not verified item by item.
axes.background: The product's main axis is RAG knowledge-base Q&A and application orchestration (doc.fastgpt.io docs on record); agent/workflow orchestration is on record; scheduling and background-execution details not verified item by item.
axes.tools: The workflow-node ecosystem is on record in the docs (knowledge retrieval / HTTP request / code-execution nodes etc.); plugin and tool-extension surfaces are on record in the docs; MCP support not verified item by item in official statements, treated as unknown.
axes.context: The knowledge base (RAG) is the core persistent knowledge surface (the product's main axis); multi-turn context and variable storage on record; cross-application memory details not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Open source and auditable (Apache + extra terms rather than the GPL family, see license); hosted versions follow official cloud terms; the mainland version fastgpt.cn carries an ICP registration on record; training-use toggle path not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: Chinese knowledge-base Q&A / RAG apps (self-hosted and controllable), a direct-mainland hosted entry (fastgpt.cn). Not a fit: wanting pure Apache 2.0 without extra terms (multi-tenant SaaS restricted), code-level agent frameworks (canvas/configuration is the main axis).
